# 01 — HTTP API reference

*Derived from `gateway/src/openapi.rs`, `gateway/src/handlers.rs`, `gateway/src/main.rs`.*

**OSRM API Gateway** version `0.1.0`. A gateway in front of osrm-routed, adding caching, rate limiting, request validation and vehicle-routing.

## Tags

| Tag | Covers |
|---|---|
| Routing | Pass-throughs to osrm-routed, with caching and validation |
| Optimisation | Depot allocation and per-vehicle routing |
| Infrastructure | Probes and metrics; never rate limited |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` | `health` | Infrastructure | Always 200, even when the engine is down. |
| GET | `/metrics` | `metrics` | Infrastructure | Prometheus exposition. Never rate limited, so a scrape is never shed. |

## Endpoint detail

### GET `/health`

Always 200, even when the engine is down.

A dashboard reads the body for detail; `/ready` is what a balancer probes,
and both deployment health checks use that instead.

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Always 200, even when the engine is down; read the body for detail |

### GET `/metrics`

Prometheus exposition. Never rate limited, so a scrape is never shed.

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Prometheus exposition |

### GET `/ready`

503 when the engine is down, so a balancer drains this node.

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Engine reachable |
| 503 | Engine unreachable; a balancer should drain this node |

### POST `/v1/match`

**Request body:** [`MatchRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#matchrequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Snap a noisy GPS trace to the road network. |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/matrix`

Note a constraint this schema cannot express: `sources` x `destinations` must not exceed MATRIX_MAX_CELLS, counting an omitted or empty list as every coordinate. Exceeding it is a 422 naming the limit.

**Request body:** [`MatrixRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#matrixrequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Duration and distance matrix between coordinates. |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/matrix-graph`

The same upstream call as `/matrix`, reshaped into a node-link graph.

Note a constraint this schema cannot express: `sources` x `destinations` must not exceed MATRIX_MAX_CELLS, counting an omitted or empty list as every coordinate. Exceeding it is a 422 naming the limit.

**Request body:** [`MatrixRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#matrixrequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | The same matrix, returned as a node-link graph. |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/nearest`

**Request body:** [`NearestRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#nearestrequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Snap a coordinate to the nearest road segment. |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/nearest/batch`

**Request body:** [`NearestBatchRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#nearestbatchrequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Snap every coordinate, in the order given. |
| 422 | Request failed validation, or exceeded the batch limit |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/route`

**Request body:** [`RouteRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#routerequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Calculate a route through an ordered list of points. |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### GET `/v1/tile/{profile}/{z}/{x}/{y}`

Vector tiles: raw protobuf, no cache, no retry.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| profile | path | `string` | yes | Routing profile |
| z | path | `integer` | yes | Zoom level; OSRM serves tiles from 12 up |
| x | path | `integer` | yes | Tile column |
| y | path | `string` | yes | Tile row, with the .mvt suffix |

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Mapbox Vector Tile |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/trip`

**Request body:** [`TripRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#triprequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Optimise the visiting order of a set of coordinates. |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached |
| default | An error from the routing engine, relayed with its own status |

### POST `/v1/vrp`

Allocate stops to depots, then solve one TSP per vehicle load.

**Request body:** [`VrpRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#vrprequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Routes, one per vehicle load |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached, or a chunk solve failed |
| 503 | Optimisation capacity exhausted; retry after the given interval |

### POST `/v1/vrp/allocate`

The allocation phase alone, with caller IDs mapped back on.

**Request body:** [`VrpRequest`](02-schema-catalogue.md#vrprequest)

**Responses:**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Stops assigned to depots |
| 422 | Request failed validation |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | The routing engine could not be reached, or a chunk solve failed |
| 503 | Optimisation capacity exhausted; retry after the given interval |
